findings.title: Removing FeatureLaunchpad leaves an unused mock in today-first-run.test.tsx
findings.problem: The test mocks FeatureLaunchpad as a stub but never queries or asserts on it, so removing the render does not break the test; the mock just becomes dead code.
findings.fix: When removing the FeatureLaunchpad render and import from TodayPage, also delete the now-orphaned vi.mock('@/app-shell/pages/today/FeatureLaunchpad', ...) block so the test does not mislead a reader. Optional housekeeping; not required for correctness.

findings.title: copy:check reject rule not stated for ASCII copy strings
findings.problem: The doc names pnpm copy:check as a gate but does not state its rule (fails on any non-ASCII byte). The doc's prose uses en/em dashes, so an implementer copying strings out of it could paste a Unicode dash.
findings.fix: Add one line to section 8: 'copy:check fails on any non-ASCII byte in user-facing copy; use a hyphen-minus - never an en/em dash.' The specified replacement strings are already ASCII and will pass.

findings.title: First-run early return does not reference FeatureLaunchpad; note it for the import-removal step
findings.problem: Only the main return renders FeatureLaunchpad; the firstRunHome early return does not. The doc does not spell this out, which could make an implementer hesitate before dropping the import.
findings.fix: Add a clarifying clause to section 9: 'the firstRunHome early return does not render FeatureLaunchpad, so dropping the import affects only the main return.' Purely clarifying.
